candidate_setup_provenance.source: only committed accepted production revision; root006 uncommitted files excluded

commands.note: Use each selected repository locked default runtime/.venv; repeat all two modes and both turn counts. The initial valid baseline/shared/50 sample plus remaining two constitute its three samples.
commands.template: python scripts/measure_adk_runtime.py --repository REPOSITORY --fixture FROZEN_FIXTURE --workloads FROZEN_WORKLOADS --turns TURNS --mode MODE --samples 3 --output NEW_REPORT.json

comparison_scope: Historical supported Runtime code/lock versus migrated Runtime code/lock; this does not isolate an SDK-only causal effect

execution.network: Internet socket connect/connect_ex and DNS calls denied in every measurement child; fixture uses httpx.MockTransport with trust_env=False
execution.production_imports: Only each selected repository runtime/src plus runtime/tests, verified module files; shared current fixture loaded by file path outside both checkouts
execution.warning_policy: Ordinary Python warnings, retained as category/count/message digests; no SDK feature flags or warning filters are disabled

phase_notes: Core import time includes importing the production Runtime/custom Gateway and verifying their source files; fixture import time separately includes the selected historical/current test_adk_runtime helper.
construction_seconds measures AdkWorkerRuntime/agent construction and start over a custom BaseLlm object, not the string-model optimization path.
first_request_seconds is preparation from first invoke to first MockTransport handler entry and is nested within workload time.
session_read_seconds measures public get_session including its copy work; read_event_copies counts returned event entries, not every internal heap copy.
callback_seconds and their aggregate overlap during parallel work and must not be added or subtracted as disjoint wall time.
provider_seconds is actual deterministic MockTransport handler/JSON work; no external provider latency or model quality is measured.

framework_seconds_excluding_mock_handler is elapsed_seconds minus only the measured MockTransport handler time. It includes deterministic fixture probes, growing nested State, effect validation and copy work, the Runtime and its adapter; it is not pure SDK CPU time. The setup/reporting/cleanup residual is separately labelled and is not pure cleanup time.
All identities and payloads are validated in the child then discarded; exported evidence contains safe counters, sizes, ordinals and digests only.
The callback aggregate covers before_run, before_model, after_model, before_tool and after_tool hooks; other orchestration/auxiliary-hook work remains in the total framework residual.
purpose: Informational custom-BaseLlm framework measurements for V418-006 R4; no timing or speedup acceptance threshold
